Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Act IX: The Threshold. Tithe Anchorage is quiet. For the first time since the Omega Arch, no fleet pursues this one. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, the Automated Fleet Key reports a second signal beneath its own on every Phantom channel. Its source lies coreward, toward Meridian. I have not identified it.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: It isn't hiding, Captain. It wants us to know it's there.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Meridian is where the ships were made, Key-Bearer. The root of the Key is there. I would like you to see it before anything else does.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Meridian holds the root of the Key. Go there, Key-Bearer. I would rather you held it than anything else out here.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: The ships were made at Meridian. I do not know what I will be when we arrive.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Whose fleet is this, Captain? Ours, or whatever is on that channel? I'd like to settle it before Gate Zero.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Tithe Anchorage, the morning after. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: The tribunal sits in the Anchorage's own wardroom, Captain. Vance asked for no counsel. He said the record would speak for him.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: Remnant engineers are on my decks. Half of them know the Dreadnought's frame better than I'd like. All of them are working.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Severant council's vessel departed at the first watch with Commander Vance aboard. Its captain transmitted one word: received.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Vance's crews took eleven unarmed hulls out of the ring gap at dawn. He didn't look back, Captain. I did.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: The logs Vance handed over go back three hundred years. The Tithe heard the same signal we hear now. They wrote down every time it changed.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: The Coalition prisoners have asked to serve aboard. I said the Captain would decide. I'd say yes.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: The grafted crews are stable. Three asked to keep their spikes. I told them that is their decision, not mine.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The fleet is ready to depart on the Captain's order.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Rustmarch. The belt's small orange star throws long shadows across ten thousand fragments. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: There she is. Rustmarch Major. My people have been drawing station plans on mess tables for a month, Captain.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: Captain. I didn't expect to see the Dreadnought again. I'm glad I was wrong.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Sensors read Tithe transponders at the belt's far edge: holdout captains who did not surrender at Grieve.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Seren Vael. The harmonic ring is steady. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The settlements on the night side burn ochre, Captain. Moderate colours, in the majority.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The night side is divided between Silence blue and ochre lamps, Captain.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The settlements burn Silence blue, Captain. The council has not answered our hail.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: Welcome back, Captain. The Choirs have argued without pause since you left. Among my people, that is a good sign.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Meridian yards: a ring of half-built hulls two thousand kilometres across. Every berth is cut to a Phantom battle-cruiser's dimensions. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: Look at the joins, Captain. No welds. They grew them. Every one of these could have been one of ours.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Power is rising along the ring. The yard's defences are waking.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Meridian. An entire world built over by the Answerers. Crystal veins run pole to pole and pulse in time with the Phantom Fleet's sync. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The root of the Automated Fleet Key lies at the north pole, Captain. Every Phantom vessel's sync passes through it.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: This is where my makers stood when they built the ships, Key-Bearer. I have a question. It is the first I have asked for myself.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Forge Echo. A black hole with a narrow, burning disc. At its photon ring hangs a twin of the Event Horizon Forge, never opened. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The structure holds empty hulls: four hundred Phantom frames without cores or crews. They cannot join the fleet. It also holds the Key's root record, intact. It is aboard, Captain.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: Squadron III is here. Twenty ships, holding station at the ring. They're not answering the Key. They're answering something else.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Hush. No stars ahead. Behind the fleet, the whole galaxy, turning. The interference is visible to the naked eye. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Answerer Listening Array is before us, Captain: twelve kilometres of crystal blades. Every blade is sounding.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: That's the sentence. That's the one it kept saying to me.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Squadron III holds station at the Array's focus, transmitting toward the galactic edge. It is not hostile.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: It isn't asking what the Precursors were, Captain. It's asking what we are.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The question is received. I cannot yet translate it with confidence.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Contacts out of the interference, Captain: empty Answerer hulls under way, and Severant emitter frigates with them. Something is herding the echoes.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: All stations. They waited until we stopped looking behind us.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: Cutter's Rest stands, Captain. The first thing my people own that nobody gave them. Well. You gave them the time.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The holdout captains have withdrawn from the belt. Their transponders are dark.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: Sentinels down. The yards are quiet. Let me go and look at them properly now.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The yard ring acknowledges the Key-Bearer's authority. Berths are open to the fleet.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: They're back. Squadron III answers to the Key again.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: They're still humming it under the sync, Captain. The question.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Every hull we brought home is one more at Gate Zero.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The root is held, Captain. The Key can be rewritten.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I did not resist. I would like that noted.
